title: Identification and Inference for Algorithmic Frontiers with Selective Labels
abstract: arXiv:2606.14977v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper provides identification results to characterize a fairness-accuracy (FA) frontier, and statistical inference tools to test hypotheses and build a confidence set for the FA-frontier, when outcomes are observed only for selected individuals. When the selection process is unrestricted but loss is measured in specific ways, we provide a characterization of the sharp identification region of the FA-frontier. When the observed distribution rules out frontier membership for a binary status quo algorithm, we construct a single alternative algorithm that improves both groups' accuracy without worsening fairness, uniformly over all admissible distributions of missing labels. translated_title: 具有选择性标签的算法前沿的识别与推断
translated_abstract: 当结果（标签）仅对被选择的个体进行观测时，本文提供了刻画公平性-准确性（FA）前沿的识别结果，以及用于检验假设和构建FA前沿置信集的统计推断工具。当选择过程不受限制但损失以特定方式度量时，我们给出了FA前沿尖锐识别区域的刻画。当观测到的分布排除了某一二元现状算法位于前沿的可能性时，我们构建了一个单一的替代算法，该算法在所有可行的缺失标签分布上一致地提高了两个群体的准确性且不损害公平性。对于任意损失函数，在可观测变量选择和严格重叠假设下，我们获得了点识别结果，提出了去偏机器学习估计量，推导了其渐近分布，并展示了如何利用该估计量进行统计推断。
tldr: 本文在标签仅对被选择个体可观测（选择性标签）的情形下，刻画了公平性-准确性前沿的识别区域，并提出了去偏机器学习估计量及统计推断方法，用以检验现有算法是否位于前沿上，并构造在不损害公平性的前提下提升各群体准确性的改进算法。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the sharp identification region of the fairness-accuracy frontier under selective labels and develops debiased machine learning estimators and inference tools to test whether an existing algorithm lies on the frontier and to construct alternative algorithms that improve accuracy without worsening fairness.
